name: Smart Auto SKU Generator for WooCommerce
author: touhidz

sections.description:
Smart Auto SKU Generator for WooCommerce automatically generates unique SKUs for your products using a smart, configurable format. The plugin creates SKUs based on product categories with the format: [2-digit category][2 letters][variable increment].

Key Features:

  • Smart Format: SKUs follow the pattern [2-digit category][2 letters][variable increment]
  • Configurable Length: Choose SKU length from 6-12 characters
  • Category-Based: SKUs are generated based on product categories
  • Bulk Generation: Generate SKUs for multiple products at once
  • Smart Overwrite: Plugin-generated SKUs are never overwritten
  • Length Adjustment: Automatically adjusts existing SKUs when length setting changes
  • Duplicate Prevention: Built-in duplicate detection and prevention
  • Comprehensive Logging: Detailed logging for troubleshooting

Example SKUs:
* Category ID 10 with prefix “AB”: 10AB01, 10AB02, etc.
* Category ID 25 with prefix “CD”: 25CD01, 25CD02, etc.

Troubleshooting:

If you encounter “Invalid or duplicated SKU” errors during bulk generation, please check the following:

  • Ensure all products have assigned categories
  • Check for duplicate SKUs in your database
  • Verify category IDs are within valid range (1-99)
  • Enable logging for detailed error tracking
sections.installation:
Requirements:
* WordPress 5.0 or higher
* WooCommerce 4.0 or higher (must be installed and activated)
* PHP 7.4 or higher

Installation Steps:
1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated on your site
2. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smart-auto-sku-generator-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
4. Use the WooCommerce → Auto SKU Generator screen to configure the plugin
5. Click “Generate SKUs for Products Without SKU” to start generating SKUs

Note: This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated. If WooCommerce is not available, you’ll see an admin notice with instructions to install or activate WooCommerce.
sections.faq:
How does the SKU format work?

The SKU format is: [2-digit category][2 letters][variable increment]

For example, if you have a category with ID 15 and the prefix “XY”, the SKUs will be: 15XY01, 15XY02, 15XY03, etc.

Can I change the SKU length?

Yes! You can set the SKU length from 6 to 12 characters in the plugin settings. The plugin will automatically adjust existing plugin-generated SKUs to match the new length.

What happens to existing SKUs?

Plugin-generated SKUs (6-character format) are never overwritten. Only manual/non-plugin SKUs are replaced when the “Overwrite Existing SKUs” option is enabled.

I’m getting “Invalid or duplicated SKU” errors. What should I do?

Please check the troubleshooting section above for common solutions. Common causes include products without categories, duplicate SKUs, or invalid category IDs.

Can I customize the prefix for specific categories?

Yes! You can set custom prefixes for specific categories in the plugin settings. Leave blank to use the automatic prefix (first 2 letters of category name).

Is this plugin compatible with my WordPress version?

This plugin requires WordPress 5.0 or higher and PHP 7.4 or higher. It’s compatible with WooCommerce 4.0 and higher.

Does this plugin work with product variations?

Yes, the plugin can generate SKUs for both simple products and product variations.

Can I import/export my SKU settings?

Yes, the plugin includes import/export functionality for your SKU generation settings.
